plain: Urged on or stirred up to act

webster.text: Moved to action; stirred up; spurred on.

example.quote: Even during the late war, while the pressure of common danger connected strongly the bond of ou union, and incited to vigorous exertion, we have fell many distressing effects of the important system.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
